description: Ordinary benchmark Runner; thin Mix CLI. ingest 10 deterministically selects unfinished documents. Preserve embeddings, pacing, budgets and deadlines. Add inspect/retry and complete status reporting.

comments.text: Action reuse recheck: existing DocumentProcessor/DocumentChunker own Markdown chunk shape, Embedding.Client owns provider routing/retry, and Checkpoint owns fenced corpus writes. The runner will orchestrate these local APIs with bounded selection and explicit command inputs; no Action or agent tool is needed because this is an offline operator-only benchmark, not an actor-facing BO or Agent operation. Contract: pinned Dataset + source Configuration + isolated Database -> limited corpus progress; side effects only corpus checkpoints/chunks, never automatic full-run.

Implemented process-scoped chunk limits, bounded one-request-at-a-time resumable Runner, deterministic source-ID selection, fixed failure codes, inspect and explicit retry, minimal corpus bootstrap, and mix liverag.corpus CLI. A fresh disposable PostgreSQL corpus database with vector extension was bootstrapped, resumed, rejected a wrong dimension, and completed a stubbed one-document run; CLI inspect succeeded. 114 focused tests passed across runner/checkpoint/chunker/chunk; mix q passed. The existing source test DB dimension was restored to 1536 after diagnosing static EctoSQL routing; bootstrap now passes the corpus pool explicitly to shared Chunk.create_table. No full upstream corpus ingestion was started and no commit/push was made.

title: [zaq-f9w.6] Implement bounded resumable runner
